## Biography & Overview

Maanasa Narayan is a Software Engineer currently working at Google on the Search team (AI Mode) in Mountain View, California. She holds a Master of Science in Computer Science from Northeastern University in Boston, MA (GPA 3.9/4.0) and a Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Science from KSIT, Visvesvaraya Technological University (VTU) in Bengaluru, India.

Throughout her career, Maanasa has focused on architecting and delivering high-availability backend microservices, robust API integrations, and intuitive frontend experiences. At Kayak, she spent three years developing Java-based airline direct connections across critical flight search, seat-map availability, baggage pricing, booking, and ticketing flows.
